name: molit-dataspace-platform-bridge
description: Connector-neutral Platform Bridge for MOLIT dataspace integration

scripts.bridge:sync:baseline: node src/cli.mjs sync --batch fixtures/discovery/baseline.json --state .local/discovery-state.json --config fixtures/discovery/config.json --approvals fixtures/discovery/approvals.json --report .local/baseline-report.json
scripts.bridge:sync:delta: node src/cli.mjs sync --batch fixtures/discovery/delta.json --state .local/discovery-state.json --config fixtures/discovery/config.json --approvals fixtures/discovery/approvals.json --report .local/delta-report.json
scripts.test:bridge: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract && npm run test:integration
scripts.test: npm run test:docs && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:profile
scripts.verify: npm run docs:style:strict && npm run docs:markdownlint && npm run registry:verify:iana && npm run registry:verify:crs && npm test && npm run profile:verify:independent
scripts.verify:release:win32-x64: npm run verify && npm run dependencies:verify && npm run toolchain:verify:jena && npm run profile:verify:jena
scripts.release:gate:win32-x64: npm run verify:release:win32-x64 && npm run release:status
